name.zh: 史黛菈与刀华强化集训对练
name.en: Stella and Toka's training camp sparring

periods.location: Kyoumon/Hagun joint training ground in Yamagata
periods.summary: Stella spars against Toka Todo, trying to bait Raikiri with Dragon Fang and counter during the recovery. Toka reads the tactic, uses Raikiri's momentum for a second strike, and defeats Stella. Across the camp Stella continues challenging Toka and finishes 3-3, but remains unsatisfied because she still feels below Toka's level.
periods.cause: Stella wants to sharpen herself before Seven Stars and overcome Toka's close-range supremacy.
periods.outcome: Toka teaches Stella that national-level fighters can use their own apparent weaknesses as traps; Stella's insecurity about her current strength grows.
periods.significance: Sets up Stella's later crisis after losing to Ouma and her request for Nene's hell training.
